summary: Iteration-35: Frontend Phase 14 wiring smoke test. Loaner Fleet Health card at /admin/system is fully wired and renders for founder with all 9 expected data-testids + 4 days-out bucket tiles + working refresh. UNABLE to complete VENDOR-route ticket drawer flows because (a) seed data contains zero VENDOR-route service tickets (all 11 returned by /api/ha/service-tickets are repair_location=IN_CLINIC), and (b) the /ha/service-tickets URL did not render the tickets table or '+ New Ticket' button (ha-tix-new) in the clinic_owner session — likely a route mismatch (sidebar shows 'Service & Repair' but the click handler routing was not verified). Code review of ServiceTicketPhase14Actions.jsx + AudinexaPipelineDrawer.jsx confirms the Phase 14 actions panel, Stamp AWB modal, loaner issue/return modals, and all data-testids exist exactly as specified, gated on t.repair_location === 'VENDOR' && !pipe.is_terminal. The IN_CLINIC-hidden contract is enforced in source.

action_items: BLOCKER for end-to-end Phase 14 frontend QA: Seed at least 2-3 VENDOR-route service tickets in tenant-sound-clinic-blr (repair_location='VENDOR'), one at AWAITING_DISPATCH (to test outbound courier booking + Stamp AWB), one at ESTIMATE_PENDING / CLIENT_APPROVED with a logged estimate (to test Issue Loaner + Mark Return Un-Repaired), and one with an active loaner (to test Return Loaner refund flow). Without this, no testing agent can verify the Phase 14 action panel renders on a live ticket.

Verify the route for the Service Tickets list page. Direct GET https://.../ha/service-tickets did not show ha-tix-new in the DOM for clinic_owner. Either fix the route or document the actual path used in the sidebar (sidebar label = 'Service & Repair'). The 11 tickets present in the API are not surfaced in any list page that this testing agent could reach via /ha/service-tickets.

Optional: add a quick e2e smoke that creates a VENDOR ticket, books an OUTBOUND courier in PENDING_AWB mode, and exercises the StampAwbModal → BOOKED flip — this is the single regression most worth automating.
critical_code_review_comments: ServiceTicketPhase14Actions.jsx line 117: GET /api/ha/serial-items?state=IN_STOCK&limit=200 in LoanerIssueModal — fine, but if the tenant has >200 IN_STOCK serials the dropdown will silently truncate. Consider server-side search or pagination.

ServiceTicketPhase14Actions.jsx line 20: window.open(url) for service-note.pdf relies on the cookie flowing through the new tab. Works for same-origin httpOnly cookies but if the PDF endpoint moves to a CDN/signed URL this will break. Defensive alternative: fetch the PDF as a blob via axios (same pattern as downloadJobCard in AudinexaPipelineDrawer) — keeps the JWT/cookie flow consistent and avoids 401s in safari strict-tracking mode.

AudinexaPipelineDrawer.jsx line 311 gating uses !pipe.is_terminal — correct, but means CLOSED tickets cannot reprint the service note even though that's a legitimate post-fact need. Consider letting print-service-note survive into CLOSED state while keeping the other 3 buttons hidden.

StampAwbModal (line 985) does not validate AWB format (length / alphanumeric) before submitting. Real partner AWBs are typically 10-13 chars; a 1-char accidental key would still PATCH through. Add a minLength=4 hint client-side.

LoanerFleetHealthCard.jsx is well-structured. Single-fetch on mount + manual refresh is appropriate; no polling needed. Consider showing last-refreshed timestamp next to the Refresh button for ops clarity.
